name: Unpaid Shops
query:
SELECT
    s.name AS shop,
    s.shop_number,
    s.status,
    t.tenant_name,
    c.rent_amount,
    c.end_date
FROM
    `tabContract` c
JOIN
    `tabShop` s ON c.shop = s.name
JOIN
    `tabTenant` t ON c.tenant = t.name
WHERE
    c.is_active = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM `tabRent Payment`
        WHERE contract = c.name
        AND month_for = MONTHNAME(CURDATE()) || ' ' || YEAR(CURDATE())
    )
